message:
fix(ci): open Release Please pull requests with a repo token (#3011)

* fix(ci): open Release Please pull requests with a repo token

The default Actions token cannot open pull requests, so Release Please
left the release branch without a PR. Use RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN, allow
manual dispatch, and keep retrying the open-or-tag job.

Signed-off-by: ZCF <291624129+zerocodefast@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(ci): keep Release Please publish on retry without branch dispatch

Drop manual dispatch so the release token stays on main-branch workflow
code. Let a retried open-or-tag job still dispatch stable publish when
Release Please reports a new release, and update the workflow contracts.

Signed-off-by: ZCF <291624129+zerocodefast@users.noreply.github.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: ZCF <291624129+zerocodefast@users.noreply.github.com>
